1.name: Balkan and Southeast Europe
1.note: Sunny narrow worn roads, scrubby green verges, red-tiled houses and fences; range adds dry slopes, wooded hills and new white-lined roads.

2.name: Central European rural roads
2.note: Sunny lined country roads with green verges and leafy trees, tiled-roof village houses; range adds flat fields, hills and forest lanes.

3.name: Northwest European roads
3.note: White-lined roads with guardrails, flat green fields and hedges, brick or rendered houses; range adds field lanes and village streets.

4.name: Nordic and Baltic roads
4.note: Narrow roads and gravel lanes with spruce and birch, red and white wooden houses, hedges; range adds forest highways and open fields.

5.name: Southern African dry roads
5.note: Deep blue sky, wide dry roads with sandy reddish shoulders, low houses and fences; range runs to open scrub flats, townships and hills.

6.name: Brazil and Paraguay red-soil towns
6.note: Red-orange soil verges, walled single-story houses, concrete poles, bright cumulus sky; ranges from dirt town streets to paved rural roads.

7.name: Russian and Ukrainian roads
7.note: Worn pale asphalt and dirt lanes, metal and brick fences, low houses under hazy skies; range adds forest-lined and flat-field highways.

8.name: Mainland Southeast Asia
8.note: Dry tropical trees, tin-roof and stilt houses, red laterite verges, concrete utility poles; ranges from busy town roads to paddy tracks.

9.name: Tropical Andean country roads
9.note: Lush green verges and broadleaf trees, yellow center lines, smeared road surface in many; ranges to busy small-town streets.

10.name: Northern South Asia roads
10.note: Hazy sky, narrow worn paved or dirt roads, brick walls and shady trees; range runs from dry bare plains to green hill roads.

11.name: Western US and Canada roads
11.note: Wide roads under clear blue skies, stucco suburbs with palms or conifers; range runs to yellow-lined prairie, sagebrush and gravel roads.

12.name: Eastern US streets and roads
12.note: Concrete or pale asphalt streets with mature leafy trees and lawns, yellow-lined rural roads; range adds pine woods and flat farm roads.

13.name: Australian gum-tree roads
13.note: Eucalyptus trees, brick bungalows with lawns, red-soil and dry grass verges, wide streets under bright sky.

14.name: Spain and Portugal sunny towns
14.note: Pale rendered house and apartment rows, tile roofs, clear blue sky, dry scrub and fields; ranges to green rural lanes and French suburbs.

15.name: Nigeria and Ghana red-dirt roads
15.note: Orange laterite shoulders, hazy pale skies, green bush and dry savanna, tin-roof shops; ranges from open two-lanes to busy roadside towns.

16.name: Malaysian palm-verge roads
16.note: Lined tropical roads with grass verges, oil palms and dense green, low red-roofed houses; range adds shophouse towns and terrace estates.

17.name: British Isles hedged roads
17.note: Gray cloudy skies, dense hedgerows along narrow lanes, brick and render houses; range adds estates, sunny glare and wooded single-tracks.

18.name: Dry Andean brick towns
18.note: Unfinished brick and adobe buildings, dusty pale streets, barren brown hills; ranges to coastal desert highways and green slopes.

19.name: Philippine concrete lanes
19.note: Pale concrete roads with grass edges, tin-roof houses and shacks, coconut and banana palms, bright tropical skies and cumulus.

20.name: Japanese town and farm roads
20.note: Dense two-story houses, many utility poles, white edge lines, rice paddies and forested hills under a bright sky.

21.name: Turkey and Georgia town streets
21.note: Balconied multi-story apartment blocks, red tile roofs, rough gravel edges, poplars and orchards; ranges from towns to stony village lanes.

22.name: Canadian and Northeast US roads
22.note: Yellow center lines, green summer verges with spruce and deciduous woods, wooden poles, bungalow suburbs; range adds forest highways.

23.name: Indonesian village roads
23.note: Single-story houses with tin or tile roofs, palms and banana plants, roadside shophouses, tropical cumulus sky.

24.name: New Zealand roads
24.note: White-lined wide roads with grass verges, paddocks and hedges, low suburban houses and wooden poles; range adds coastal scrub and town roads.

25.name: East African red-dirt roads
25.note: Orange-red laterite tracks and shoulders, lush green bush, banana and tall trees, scattered tin roofs; range adds paved roads and dry flats.

26.name: Chilean towns and dry roads
26.note: Single-story colorful houses behind fences, dense overhead wires, dry hills; ranges to Patagonian steppe and forest gravel roads.

27.name: Argentina and Uruguay pampas
27.note: Flat grassy plains, dirt and narrow paved roads, low brick houses, wide open sky; ranges from town side streets to empty two-lanes.

28.name: Oman, UAE, Qatar sand roads
28.note: Pale sand verges, beige walled villas, lamp-lined multi-lane highways, hazy white sky; ranges from open desert to city streets.

29.name: Mexican painted-house streets
29.note: Brightly painted flat-roof concrete houses, tangled overhead wires, dusty pale roads; ranges from dense town streets to dry scrub plains.

30.name: Central Asian steppe villages
30.note: Dusty cracked roads, metal fences and gates, small tin-roof houses, flat steppe; the camera car's hood shows in many shots.

31.name: Tunisia and Malta dry towns
31.note: Whitewashed flat-roof buildings, wide hazy boulevards, dry scrub and olive verges, bleached sky; ranges to flat empty desert roads.

32.name: Levant pale-stone suburbs
32.note: Beige stone apartment blocks, red-white or black-white curbs, hazy pale sky, flat dry plains; ranges from suburb streets to desert motorways.

33.name: Taiwan and Hong Kong streets
33.note: Tiled multi-story buildings, parked scooters, double-yellow center lines, lush subtropical hill roads with guardrails.

34.name: Sri Lankan and South Indian lanes
34.note: Narrow paved or red-earth lanes under coconut palms and dense green, walls and low houses; range adds lined two-lanes and town strips.

35.name: Central American hill roads
35.note: Yellow-lined two-lanes through lush green scrub and pines, cloudy hills, walled low houses; range adds cut slopes and town edges.

36.name: South Korean streets and valleys
36.note: Gray asphalt with yellow center lines, tiled and brick multi-story shop blocks, dry brown hills; ranges from city streets to rural valleys.

37.name: North Atlantic treeless roads
37.note: Treeless green or brown plains and slopes, gray overcast, open two-lanes and gravel roads; range adds fjord shores and small town streets.

38.name: Senegal sandy Sahel roads
38.note: Pale yellow sand streets and shoulders, block-walled compounds, sparse dry trees; range runs to open savanna and new black-top highways.

39.name: Mongolian steppe roads
39.note: Camera car with a tarp-bundled roof rack in view, open steppe, plank-fenced towns with colored roofs; range adds dirt tracks and larch.

40.name: Caribbean island house roads
40.note: Palms and lush hedges, white railed-porch concrete houses, sunny cumulus sky; ranges from jungle lanes to dry Curacao scrubland.
